Package aor.proj3t.service.interfaces

Interface AuthService

All Known Implementing Classes:
AuthServiceImpl
public interface AuthService
Service interface for authentication operations. This interface defines the contract for user authentication, session management, and security-related operations within the application.

Core authentication services include:

  • User Authentication: Credential validation and login processing
  • Session Management: JWT token generation and session tracking
  • Logout Operations: Session termination and cleanup
  • Security Integration: Password verification and token management

This service ensures secure authentication workflows with proper session management, audit logging, and integration with JWT token utilities for stateless authentication in the application.

  • Method Details

    • login

      LoginResponseDTO login(LoginDTO loginDto, String ipAddress, String userAgent)
      Authenticates a user with the provided credentials and creates a new session. This method now handles two-factor authentication by returning different response types based on whether 2FA is enabled for the user.
      Parameters:
      loginDto - the login data containing email and password
      ipAddress - the IP address of the client making the login request
      userAgent - the user agent string from the client's browser
      Returns:
      a LoginResponseDTO indicating whether 2FA is required or providing the session token

    • completeTwoFactorLogin

      String completeTwoFactorLogin(String temporaryToken, String twoFactorCode, String ipAddress, String userAgent)
      Completes the two-factor authentication login process. Verifies the 2FA code and issues a full session token upon successful verification.
      Parameters:
      temporaryToken - the temporary token issued during initial login
      twoFactorCode - the 2FA code (TOTP or backup code)
      ipAddress - the IP address of the client
      userAgent - the user agent string from the client's browser
      Returns:
      a JWT session token for the authenticated session

    • logout

      void logout(Long userId, String token)
      Logs out a user by invalidating their current session. Marks the session as inactive to prevent further use of the token.
      Parameters:
      userId - the ID of the user logging out
      token - the JWT token of the session to be invalidated
